Package gov.cdc.izgateway.soap.fault

Class DestinationConnectionFault

java.lang.Object
java.lang.Throwable
java.lang.Exception
gov.cdc.izgateway.soap.fault.Fault
gov.cdc.izgateway.soap.fault.DestinationConnectionFault
All Implemented Interfaces:
HasDestinationId, HasDestinationUri, FaultSupport, Serializable
public class DestinationConnectionFault extends Fault implements HasDestinationUri
A DestinationConnectionFault records information about faults that occur when trying to connect to a destination.
